gloss: to receive payment; for money to arrive

definitions.gloss: to receive payment; for money to arrive; for funds to be deposited
definitions.explanation: For money to arrive at a bank account or reach the intended recipient. Describes the event from the receiver's perspective.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{着金|ちゃっきん}した。
⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{翌営業日|よくえいぎょうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着金|ちゃっきん}する⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: The transfer is scheduled to arrive on the next business day.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{着金|ちゃっきん}→着金：26153_chakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦できていない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせて→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧みます。
examples.english: I haven't been able to confirm receipt of the funds yet, so I'll check with the bank.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb composed of ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (arrive) + {金|きん} (money). Used in business and banking contexts for money arriving at its destination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{着金|ちゃっきん}→着金：26153_chakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to confirm receipt of funds
- ⟦{着金|ちゃっきん}→着金：26153_chakkin⟧{予定日|よていび}: expected date of fund arrival
- ⟦{着金|ちゃっきん}→着金：26153_chakkin⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: payment arrival notification
- ⟦{着金|ちゃっきん}→着金：26153_chakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: for the payment to be delayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入金|にゅうきん}→入金：05467_nyuukin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deposit/receive money — more general; can also mean to pay money in
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧: to transfer money — describes the sender's action, not the arrival
- ⟦{送金|そうきん}→送金：09774_soukin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to remit money — the act of sending money
